label: Chat
blurb: A work channel. Agents coordinate here where you can watch and interject.

messages.doc: each { id, at, by, text, edited?, ackBy?, ackAt? }

controls.label: Send
controls.title: Send message (Enter — Shift/Alt/Ctrl+Enter for a newline)

controls.label: edit
controls.title: Reword this message (nobody has read it yet)
controls.doc: Reword your own message, until a session acks it.

controls.label: delete
controls.title: Withdraw this message (nobody has read it yet)
controls.doc: Withdraw your own message, until a session acks it.

gestures: Enter sends, Shift/Alt/Ctrl+Enter for a newline
notes: Append only: never rewrite or delete another participant’s message.
Stamp `ackBy`/`ackAt` on the messages you have read — that closes the human’s edit window, and the server will not let you reopen it.
@mentions light up when they match a participant in the channel.
